name: Hoot Lens
oneLiner: Trace website snags to recorded visits, click maps and timed replay moments before changing code.
description:
Find one recurring website snag and follow its evidence to a recorded visit, click map or timed replay moment. Hoot Lens gives Claude recordings, narratives, heatmaps, funnels, traffic and JavaScript errors from the sites and permissions you choose.

Start with a question such as: "Where do mobile visitors get stuck on this page?" Claude can inspect findings, follow a representative recording and cite the page, release, device, date window and sample size. Historical behavior is evidence to investigate, not proof of a current defect, a visitor's feelings or the cause of a change.

Try the anonymous synthetic Fieldnote walkthrough at https://hootlens.com/guides/trace-a-website-snag-with-your-agent/ before sharing your own site. The demo requires no account or password. Your own site uses Hoot Lens sign-in, with access enforced by account, site and approved scopes. Read and replay expose authorized recorded site content. Write tools require their corresponding approved permissions.

When site AI explanations are enabled, explain_snags can send aggregated counts to the explanation provider and consume the monthly project allowance. The first investigation can use recorded findings and narratives without that tool.

Privacy: passwords, payment fields and one-time codes are never captured. Other form values remain masked unless the site explicitly allowlists them. Capture respects site privacy and consent settings, Global Privacy Control and Do Not Track. Recorded content is untrusted data.

Setup: https://hootlens.com/guides/give-your-coding-agent-real-user-behavior-data/
Support: support@hootlens.com
